Details: A model tool that pre-checks low-rise residential projects in Toronto against zoning, key Building Code rules and other approvals, then makes a draft report. A prototype for TKS, not a published product.

Toronto + Ontario rules. Low-rise residential only: additions, decks, sheds, garages, pools, garden suites, laneway suites, secondary suites, multiplexes (2-4 units), new houses. Zones R and RD first (RS, RT, RM later).
Sources = every document and link. Project Types = what the tool covers. Rules Table = every rule with limit + section. Test Cases = examples with expected answers. Build Plan = order to build in.
Code decides pass/fail, never the AI. AI is only added at the end to read plans and do the vibes check.
Every result shows the bylaw section and a confidence level: High, Verify, or Needs human check.
Missing info = 'Need more info', never PASS.
Grey properties (old bylaws) and site-specific exceptions = stop or warn. Never guess.
Safety (Building Code) results always say 'a qualified designer must confirm'. Never say 'safe' or 'approved'.
Report label: 'Draft pre-check for review. Not an approval.'
Many limits come from the zone label (e.g. RD (f12.0; a370; d0.6)) and overlay maps (HT height, ST storeys, lot coverage). The tool must ask for these or look them up.
1) Download sources in 'Download order'. 2) Check each rule in Rules Table against the PDF and tick 'Verified vs PDF'. 3) Fill the 'To extract' rows (BC-06 to BC-11).
Toronto Zoning By-law 569-2013 web consolidation (city-wide amendments to Apr 30, 2026), City of Toronto permit pages, Ontario Building Code 2024 references. Checked Nov 10, 2026.
Download this workbook as .xlsx (or each tab as CSV) and give it to Claude Code with the Build Plan. Build one step at a time and run the Test Cases after each step.
